newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds end with scattered soy trades.
newsitem.headline: European feeds end with scattered soy trades.

text.p: European meal and feeds closed on Friday with only scattered trades in nearby proteins, with most players sidelined ahead of key USDA data due out on Monday.
Traders said the prospect of soybean acreage figures from the U.S. had forced many to suspend all but essential trades and a further drop on Chicago this afternoon hindered late activity.

Afloat South American soymeal was traded but quantites were not large and buyer reluctance to trade in further out positions was still evident. Tapioca saw one trade reported but the Dutch swine fever crisis continued to dampen offtake, traders said.
